panels.title: Apparent Wind Speed
panels.description: sensor.nmea_aws — the boat's own masthead instrument reading, not corrected for boat motion.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_aws")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "aws")

panels.title: Wind Rose — Direction Frequency (24h)
panels.description: Apparent wind angle bucketed into 16 compass sectors, counted over the last 24h, plotted as a north-up wedge rose (N is up, clockwise) — one solid petal per direction, length = how often the wind sat there; not a true compass bearing, relative-to-bow like the rest of this dashboard. Grafana has no native radial-chart panel (full stacked-by-speed rose tracked separately for later research) — background grid is plain Cartesian, not compass rings, read petal direction/length, not the axis numbers.

targets.query:
import "math"
import "array"
dirs = ["N","NNE","NE","ENE","E","ESE","SE","SSE","S","SSW","SW","WSW","W","WNW","NW","NNW"]
zeros = array.from(rows: [
  {sector: 0.0, dir: "N"}, {sector: 1.0, dir: "NNE"}, {sector: 2.0, dir: "NE"}, {sector: 3.0, dir: "ENE"},
  {sector: 4.0, dir: "E"}, {sector: 5.0, dir: "ESE"}, {sector: 6.0, dir: "SE"}, {sector: 7.0, dir: "SSE"},
  {sector: 8.0, dir: "S"}, {sector: 9.0, dir: "SSW"}, {sector: 10.0, dir: "SW"}, {sector: 11.0, dir: "WSW"},
  {sector: 12.0, dir: "W"}, {sector: 13.0, dir: "WNW"}, {sector: 14.0, dir: "NW"}, {sector: 15.0, dir: "NNW"}
]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with count: 0 }))
real = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_awa")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with sector: math.floor(x: (math.mod(x: r._value, y: 360.0) / 22.5)) }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with dir: dirs[int(v: r.sector)] }))
  |> group(columns: ["sector", "dir"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "count"})
  |> keep(columns: ["sector", "dir", "count"])
sectors = union(tables: [real, zeros])
  |> group(columns: ["sector", "dir"])
  |> sum(column: "count")
  |> group()
pi = 3.14159265358979
p0 = sectors |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with ord: 0, x: 0.0, y: 0.0 }))
p1 = sectors |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with ord: 1, ang: (r.sector * 22.5 - 11.0) * pi / 180.0 })) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with x: float(v: r.count) * math.sin(x: r.ang), y: float(v: r.count) * math.cos(x: r.ang) }))
p2 = sectors |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with ord: 2, ang: (r.sector * 22.5 - 5.5) * pi / 180.0 })) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with x: float(v: r.count) * math.sin(x: r.ang), y: float(v: r.count) * math.cos(x: r.ang) }))
p3 = sectors |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with ord: 3, ang: (r.sector * 22.5) * pi / 180.0 })) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with x: float(v: r.count) * math.sin(x: r.ang), y: float(v: r.count) * math.cos(x: r.ang) }))
p4 = sectors |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with ord: 4, ang: (r.sector * 22.5 + 5.5) * pi / 180.0 })) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with x: float(v: r.count) * math.sin(x: r.ang), y: float(v: r.count) * math.cos(x: r.ang) }))
p5 = sectors |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with ord: 5, ang: (r.sector * 22.5 + 11.0) * pi / 180.0 })) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with x: float(v: r.count) * math.sin(x: r.ang), y: float(v: r.count) * math.cos(x: r.ang) }))
p6 = sectors |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with ord: 6, x: 0.0, y: 0.0 }))
union(tables: [p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6])
  |> group(columns: ["sector", "dir"])
  |> sort(columns: ["ord"])
  |> keep(columns: ["dir", "x", "y"])
  |> yield(name: "windrose")

panels.title: Barometric Pressure
panels.description: sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure — modeled (Met.no), no barometer fitted on the boat.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> yield(name: "pressure")

panels.title: Pressure Trend (3h)
panels.description: Now vs. ~3h ago. A steady fall is the classic front-approaching signal — worth more than the raw number.

targets.query:
cur = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "cur" }))
old = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -3h30m, stop: -2h30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "old" }))
union(tables: [cur, old])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_measurement"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with delta: r.cur - r.old }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "delta"])
  |> yield(name: "delta")

from(bucket: "Sisu")
